svg.title: OpenPoke agent overload presentation — 11 slides
svg.desc: 100 active executions globally, 100 waiting, one active per Execution Agent. Original sources are retained. Historical validation: latest 9/10, earlier 10/10; 100-worker runtime checks pending.

text.tspan: Search relevant EAs, bound loaded memory, and control simultaneous executions.

Resolve links, search if needed, then inspect the current record.
Conflicting confirmed invoice / case / task IDs exclude a match.
Ambiguous identity → clarify. Missing embeddings → show degraded discovery.
